title: Son, mother 84: fell in the bathroom, hip pain, can't get up, talking normally

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 1630 Ortega Street. It's my mother, she's 84.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She slipped and fell in the bathroom. Her hip hurts really bad and she can't get up off the floor.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, she says she didn't hit her head. She landed on her hip.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and talking normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, she's talking normally, she's completely with it, she's just in a lot of pain.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can she move her arms and legs?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Her arms are fine. It's just the hip, she can't put any weight on that leg because it hurts.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Don't try to move her.
